text: Royal Canadian Legion Scarboro Branch 13 has been a cornerstone of the Birch Cliff community for more than a century. Operating from the Scarboro Veterans Memorial Hall at 1577 Kingston Road, built in 1922 following the First World War, the Branch has provided generations of veterans, their families and local residents with a place of remembrance, fellowship and community service. Reflecting strong advocacy from local residents, veterans, and community members, a new signalized pedestrian crossing at Kingston Road and Kildonan Drive/Eastwood Avenue in front of the Legion is currently being installed. This initiative, intended to improve safety for seniors, veterans, people with disabilities and other vulnerable road users, was successfully approved by Scarborough Community Council and City Council and is now moving toward implementation by this fall.
